eligibility.quote:
Issue gives reproduction steps ("3. In the install workspace, replace the new shared library with the old .so
4. Run the generated rclcpp_components main executable.") and the observed behaviour; a maintainer accepts the check in PR #2415: "If that was the case, then we should definitely fail, since we failed to do what the user asked us to do."

failed_conditions.quote: Theoretically this state _shouldn't_ happen, but it did for me because of cached .so binaries that didn't have the class inside.
Executor starts running but with no node inside, and just hangs on waiting for work forever.

loudness.quote: No diagnostic: the host logs nothing when the class is missing and spins an empty executor ("Executor starts running but with no node inside, and just hangs on waiting for work forever."). Expected behaviour per the reporter: "Node to throw exception and crash."

resolution.quote: Merged into rolling on 2024-02-13 and the issue closed. In the PR discussion the author shows a failing load with a test executable, not the reporter's library: "[ERROR] [1707491029.558037381] [test_component_does_not_exist_executable]: Failed to load library Could not create instance of type rclcpp_components::NodeFactoryTemplate<test_rclcpp_components::DoesNotExist>". The reporter's Humble composition has no released fix.

notes: Adjudicated case C3-035: fully agrees with specification eligibility (E1-E4 step 6), failed conditions, loudness (silent_documented), and resolution status (recommended).
